description:
412 edited images. 400-person event. Delivered at hour 44. Every image used in the leadership report the next morning.

The challenge was not speed. It was selection. A full-day event generates 1,400 to 1,800 captures. The 48-hour window does not allow for slow selection.

Our process uses three passes. First pass in the field eliminates technical failures on site. Second pass after the event cuts to candidates by segment. Third pass applies the final standard: one definitive image per moment, no near-misses, no duplicates.

The result is a delivery that requires no further editing from the client's communications team.

What is the longest you have waited for post-event image delivery, and how did it affect your ability to use the content?

Planning a corporate event? If you need photo/video with clear delivery standards and fast turnaround, message us. We'll share a sample shot list and a clear turnaround timeline.
